💧 WEEKLY WATER CHANGE 💧 One of the most important parts of keeping African cichlids healthy is maintaining good water quality. I do a weekly water change to: 🐟 Remove accumulated waste and pollutants 💧 Replenish essential minerals ⚖️ Help maintain stable water parameters 🧼 Keep the tank clean and the fish healthy 📉 Reduce the buildup of nitrates and other unwanted compounds Remember: clean water = healthy fish. Your filtration system is important, but it doesn’t replace regular water changes.
